name: Astral Sever
summary: Astral Sever is a 4-player co-op extraction game. You are not a hero, you are a Pilot: a disposable mercenary sent into the Data Rifts to do the SDF's dirty work. Match your Resonance to the Rift's Magnitude, hunt colossal Titans, carve off their parts, and smuggle the loot back past the scanners. Every piece torn off enrages the Titan, and the deadlier the prey, the bigger the payout. Developed and published by Everreach Labs, Inc. Coming to PC.
